question: Should core Control UI own authenticated remote catalog artwork through this new Gateway route, including the bounded SVG-to-PNG browser path?
rationale: This is a new core Gateway and browser capability rather than a repair of an established contract, and the protected maintainer label indicates that the permanent ownership and security boundary require explicit sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the identity proxy
options.body: Adopt the additive protocol field and authenticated same-origin route after refreshed current-head review and diagnostic live proof.

options.title: Keep artwork local-only
options.body: Retain bundled artwork and monograms and avoid adding remote catalog image fetching to the core Gateway.

options.title: Narrow remote formats
options.body: Accept remote raster artwork now but defer SVG support until a smaller server-side normalization contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the identity proxy
recommendation.body: Adopt the additive protocol field and authenticated same-origin route after refreshed current-head review and diagnostic live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work owns the closest authenticated Control UI HTTP-route patterns and associated trust boundary.
